free_text_notes.physician_note: 82-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes, admitted 4/24 with acute decompensated heart failure (EF 30%). Net negative 3.5 L this admission; dyspnea back to baseline. 4/30 08:20: Creatinine rose from 1.4 to 2.1 after diuresis; holding diuretics and rechecking. The patient uses a walking stick at home. They brought it to the hospital. They have been using it during all mobilisation sessions this week and are comfortable with it.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Up in chair for meals. Pain controlled. Platelet count was mildly low on the first blood test. A repeat test on day 2 showed it had returned to the normal range without any treatment.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: CM following for discharge planning. Patient has questions about what to eat at home. Still need to book the PCP appointment.
